QuestInfo.name: Test Operation
QuestInfo.0: Take the Blue Dragon Cannon CAREFULLY to #b#p3001000##k over at #b#m401000000##k.
QuestInfo.1: Upon completing the transportation mission, #b#p3001000##k gave you a firing mission. Before you do anything else, go see #b#p3001007##k at #b#m401000002##k.
QuestInfo.2: It looks like #p3001007# has been doing various patrol missions. But who's this #b'all-star personnel'#k?

0.0: I hope you've brought the cannon. I received a message from #m400000000# that the Blue Dragon Cannon was on its way. \r\n#L0##bGot it right here.#l\n#k
0.1: No time like the present, then. We have the location of a Specter supply base, thanks to #p3001007# and the '#bsuperstar#k.'\r\n#L0##bWho's the superstar?#l\n#k
0.2: She's our little secret weapon.\r\n#L0##bYou're acting all happy again.#l\n#k
0.3: Why wouldn't I be? We have the cannon, we have a target. You can do the math. I hope you're ready to make some very large fireworks.\r\n#L0##bI don't know how to fire a cannon...#l\n#k
0.4: The Blue Dragon Cannon is a product of the ancient Nova. Your mental clarity is far more than any expertise. Clear your mind, and let the spirits guide you.\r\n#L0##bI will commune with the spirits of warriors past and destroy our enemy!#l\n#k
0.5: Yes, wonderful. Go speak with #b#p3001007##k and get the coordinates. I'll be waiting with my ear plugs.\r\n#r#e(If you accept, you will automatically move to the relevant field.)\r\n

yes.0: I can't wait to see the fireball! Oh, this is so exciting!

no.0: We should fire as soon as we can. Take care of your business and get back here on the double.

1.0: Ah, Kaiser! I just need to confirm those coordinates on my map! Give me a sec, okay?
